biotools.summary:
Automatically detects duplicate and near-duplicate DICOM image series in large medical imaging datasets. Uses a tiered pipeline combining DICOM metadata analysis, SHA-based pixel hashing, and image similarity metrics (SSIM, cosine, MAD) to identify exact copies, re-exported series, and near-identical acquisitions. All findings are reported for human expert review — no files are modified or deleted automatically.

For scenarios requiring strict, image-level deduplication based on pixel content, fully agnostic to metadata changes, consider using [https://bio.tools/image_duplicate_check_tool]
